records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production 2D SIDE-VIEW game animation sprite sheet, exact 4 columns by 2 rows = 8 evenly spaced equal rectangular cells, landscape 2:1 canvas. Transparent alpha background. One consistent creature repeated in every cell with identical body proportions and pen style, facing RIGHT. Clean charming medieval sketchbook BLACK INK outline only, sparse short inner strokes, no color, no filled black masses, no textured gray shading, no scenery, no ground strip, no text, no numbers, no grid lines. Clear simple low-detail shapes readable at 60 pixels. Entire creature stays within its own equal cell with at least 10% padding; body center at the same cell-local coordinate, ground feet at the same cell-local baseline. Exact cell order left-to-right top row first, then bottom row. Top row 4 consecutive distinct locomotion poses. Bottom row: cell5 startled hurt recoil, cell6 falling/tumbling reaction (no gore), cell7 resting side-on downed pose with eyes closed, cell8 same downed pose with tiny alternate ear/wing position. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Eight cells, not one scene. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA with transparent interiors where possible.
Subject: One gentle small rabbit with two long upright ears, tiny dot eye, short rounded body, four simple paws and fluffy round tail. Top row shows four hopping/walking phases: crouched push, rear-leg extension, compact airborne tuck, front-paw landing. Bottom row hurt/recoil, falling, two calm downed poses. Simple clean bold-ish ink contours and almost no fur hatching.

revisions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this 4 columns ×2 rows bat monster animation sprite sheet. Preserve the charming simple black ink creature identity, consistent proportions, all eight poses and their order. Fix ONLY cell isolation: each complete bat including both wingtips and feet must fit fully inside its own equal cell, with at least 15 percent empty transparent padding around its entire silhouette. The third top-row bat's horizontal wing must NOT cross into the fourth cell. The fourth top-row bat's downward wings must NOT cross into the bottom row. Make ALL eight bats slightly smaller within their cells if necessary, at one common scale. Four equal columns and two equal rows across the whole canvas, no drawn grid, no text, no numbers. Top row: four flight flap poses. Bottom row: hurt, tumbling, downed, alternate downed. True transparent alpha background. No new scenery, no extra marks, no ground or shadow. Keep all body centers aligned at consistent cell-local coordinates.
